summary: Canaan Inc. filed a Form 6-K providing an unaudited operational update for April 2026, covering bitcoin production, hashrate, and cryptocurrency holdings. The report discloses 90 BTC mined, a record treasury of 1,826 BTC and 3,952 ETH, and installed hashrate of 10.97 EH/s (non-JV). No strategic transaction, shareholder vote, or corporate action is involved. This is a routine current report of foreign private issuer operations, not a special situation. As a Form 6-K, it serves the US-equivalent function of a voluntary operational update under the 1934 Act.
